context: Official Step-mode screen examples, used as static hardware references. They do not represent the current setup or a connected device.

pads.mapping: The grey viewport in step-piano-roll.jpg spans x=0..1023 and y=328..455. Divide into 16 columns of 64 pixels and 8 rows of 16 pixels. Only the five note starts within this viewport are lit; note lengths are represented on the screen.
pads.color_note: Row colors follow the official Step matrix illustration, not the monochrome piano roll. Device RGB colors can be customized.

files.description: Left display: note parameters in Step mode.
Right display: piano roll in Step mode.
